summary: The diff implements follow/unfollow backend persistence (REQ-1), frontend mutation hooks in useQueries.ts (REQ-3), and UserProfilePage follow button wiring (REQ-2). Most requirements are addressed, but several specific acceptance criteria cannot be fully confirmed due to truncated diff content, and one AC around error toast/state revert is not clearly evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: If the backend call fails, an error toast is shown and the button state reverts
missing_requirements.reason: The UserProfilePage.tsx diff is truncated and the onError handler with toast and state revert logic cannot be confirmed as implemented.

missing_requirements.requirement: On mutation success, queries for the target user's profile and follower/following counts are invalidated and refetched; the isFollowing status is also refetched after follow/unfollow
missing_requirements.reason: The useQueries.ts diff is truncated. The file summary mentions useFollowUser invalidates the notifications query but does not confirm invalidation of follower/following count queries and isFollowing status for both useFollowUser and useUnfollowUser.

hallucinated_features.description: A migration module (backend/migration.mo) was added that converts old followingMap from Map<Principal, Principal> to Map<Principal, Set<Principal>> and old followersMap from Map<Principal, Map<Principal, ()>> to Map<Principal, Set<Principal>>
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request only asked for stable state persistence of follow relationships. A migration module converting old data structures was not requested and represents additional scope beyond the requirements.
